# Freq plot

```{r}
df <- read_xlsx("R_CD4_CTL3.xlsx")
df

colnames(df)[1] ="sample"

df <- df %>% separate(sample, into = c(NA, NA, "Batch","Donor", "Group"), sep = "_", remove = F)
df$Group <- gsub(df$Group, pattern = "\\.fcs", replacement = "")
df
```

Filter out one donor that was measured twice

```{r}
df <- df %>% dplyr::filter(!(Donor == "p51" & Batch == "Batch6"))

df
```


```{r}
plot_list <- list()

for(i in 5:6){
  df_filt <- df %>% select(1:4,i)
  colnames(df_filt)[5] <- "value"
  df_filt$value <- as.numeric(df_filt$value)

  plot <- df_filt %>% ggplot(aes(x = Group,
             y = value)) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA, aes(fill = Group), alpha = 0.5) +
          geom_dotplot(binaxis='y', stackdir='center', dotsize=0) + 
     geom_jitter(binaxis='y', position=position_jitter(width = 0.1, height = 0.05), 
                 size = 2.5, stackdir='center', aes(color = Group)) + 
     theme_classic() + xlab("") +
     #scale_color_manual(values = c("indianred2","grey70")) +
     #scale_fill_manual(values = c("indianred2","grey70")) +
     #geom_line(aes(group = Sample, alpha = 0.1)) +

  xlab("") +  ylab("") +
        scale_y_continuous(expand = c(0,NA), limits = c(0,NA))+
      ggpubr::stat_compare_means(comparisons = list(c(1,2),c(1,3),c(1,4))) + 
     ggtitle(colnames(df)[i]) + ggtheme() + 
    theme(axis.ticks.x = element_blank()) +
    #scale_fill_manual(values = c("grey70", "red3","#d3bc5fff")) +
    #scale_color_manual(values = c("grey70","red3","#d3bc5fff")) +
    Seurat::NoLegend()
    print(plot)
    plot_list[[i-3]] <- plot
  
}

```

Highlight representative donors

```{r}
i = 6
df_filt <- df %>% select(1:4,i)
  colnames(df_filt)[5] <- "value"
  df_filt$value <- as.numeric(df_filt$value)

  plot <- df_filt %>% ggplot(aes(x = factor(Group, levels = c("hd","fg","uc","cd")),
             y = value)) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA, aes(fill = Group), alpha = 0.5) +
          geom_dotplot(binaxis='y', stackdir='center', dotsize=0) + 
     geom_jitter(
  aes(color = Donor %in% c("p71", "p34", "HD1", "p85"),
      size = Donor %in% c("p71", "p34", "HD1", "p85")),
  position = position_jitter(width = 0.1, height = 0.05, seed = 123)
) +
scale_color_manual(values = c("FALSE" = "grey65", "TRUE" = "red")) +
scale_size_manual(values = c("FALSE" = 2.5, "TRUE" = 3.5)) +
    theme_classic() + xlab("") +
     scale_color_manual(values = c("hd" = "#00bfc4ff", "fg" = "#7cae00ff", "uc" = "#c77cffff", "cd" = "#f8766dff")) +
     scale_fill_manual(values = c("hd" = "#00bfc4ff", "fg" = "#7cae00ff", "uc" = "#c77cffff", "cd" = "#f8766dff")) +
     xlab("") +  ylab("") +
        scale_y_continuous(expand = c(0,NA), limits = c(0,NA))+
      ggpubr::stat_compare_means(comparisons = list(c(1,4),c(2,4),c(3,4),c(1,3),c(2,3))) + 
     ggtitle(colnames(df)[i]) + ggtheme() + 
    theme(axis.ticks.x = element_blank()) +
    Seurat::NoLegend()
    print(plot)
```


## Update metadata change

```{r}
md_5p_new <- read_csv("../predict_5p_metadata_20260819.csv")

md_groups_join <- md_5p_new %>% dplyr::filter(timepoint == "T0") %>% 
  group_by(participant_id, diagnosis) %>% tally()

md_groups_join

df_test_groups <- df

df_test_groups
df_test_groups <- df_test_groups %>% mutate(participant_id = if_else(nchar(Donor) == 3, gsub(df_test_groups$Donor, pattern = "^p", replacement = "001-0"), if_else(
 nchar(Donor) == 4, gsub(df_test_groups$Donor, pattern = "^p", replacement = "001-"), Donor))) 


df_test_groups <- df_test_groups %>% left_join(md_groups_join %>% dplyr::select(group2 = diagnosis, participant_id))


df_test_groups %>% group_by(participant_id, group2, Group) %>% tally() 
```
No discrepancies in new metadata. Keep the orig plots. 




# Correlation CD4 CTL facs vs scRNAseq

### Gut

```{r}

library(tidyr)

md_gut_5p <- read_csv("250121_Gut_5p_metadata.csv")

df4 <- md_gut_5p %>% 
  mutate(data_folder = paste(participant_id, timepoint, tissue, layer, diagnosis, sep = "_")) %>% 
  group_by(data_folder, integrated_snn_res.0.6) %>% 
  summarise(n = n()) %>% 
  unique() %>% 
  mutate(freq = n / sum(n))  %>%
dplyr::select(-n)  %>% 
pivot_wider(names_from = integrated_snn_res.0.6, values_from = freq, values_fill = 0)  %>% 
tidyr::pivot_longer(!data_folder, names_to = "seurat_clusters", values_to = "freq")


df5 <- df4 %>% 
  pivot_wider(names_from = seurat_clusters, names_prefix = "c", values_from = freq) %>% 
  separate(data_folder, into = c("patient", "time", "tissue", "layer", "diagnosis"), sep = "_") 

df5

df5 %>% 
  dplyr::filter(time == 'T0' & layer == "LP" & tissue == "ILE") %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x = diagnosis, y = c7)) +
  geom_boxplot()

df5
df5 %>% dplyr::filter(substr(patient,1,3)=="003")

df5$Donor <- gsub(df5$patient, pattern = "001-00", replacement = "p")
df5$Donor <- gsub(df5$Donor, pattern = "001-0", replacement = "p")
df5$Donor <- gsub(df5$Donor, pattern = "001-", replacement = "p")
df5$Donor <- gsub(df5$Donor, pattern = "003-00", replacement = "p30")
df5$Donor <- gsub(df5$Donor, pattern = "003-0", replacement = "p3")

table(df5$Donor %in% df$Donor)
table(df$Donor %in% df5$Donor)

df8 <- left_join(df, dplyr::select(df5 %>% dplyr::filter(time == "T0" & layer == 'LP' & tissue == "ILE"), Donor, c7))

df8



colnames(df)
```


```{r}

for(i in 5:6){
  plt <- df8 %>% 
  dplyr::select(cor_var = i,c7, Group) %>% 
        mutate(cor_var = as.numeric(cor_var)) %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x = cor_var, y = c7)) +
  geom_point(aes(color = Group)) +
 geom_smooth(method=lm) +
  ggpubr::stat_cor() + ggtitle(colnames(df8)[i])
  
  print(plt)
}


```

# AntiTNF response

```{r}
df_bl8
```



```{r}
for(i in 5:6){
  
  pos <- position_jitter(width = 0.05, height = 0)
  
  plt <- df_bl8 %>% 
    mutate(antitnf_response = if_else(Donor == "p10", "PR", antitnf_response)) %>% 
    mutate(antitnf_response = if_else(Donor == "p103", "FR", antitnf_response)) %>% 
    mutate(antitnf_response = if_else(antitnf_response == "NOA", "NM", antitnf_response)) %>% 
    dplyr::select(Donor, cor_var = i, antitnf_response, Group, Batch) %>% 
    mutate(cor_var = as.numeric(cor_var)) %>% 
    dplyr::filter(Group == "cd" & !(Donor == "p51" & Batch == "Batch6")) %>% 
    ggplot(aes(x = factor(antitnf_response, levels = c("NM","FR","PR")), y = cor_var)) +
    geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA, aes(fill = antitnf_response), alpha = 0.4, width = 0.8) + 
    geom_dotplot(binaxis = "y", stackdir = "center", dotsize = 0) + 
    geom_jitter(position = pos, size = 2, aes(color = antitnf_response)) +
    geom_text(aes(label = Donor),
              position = pos,
              vjust = -0.8,
              size = 3) +
    theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 22),
          axis.line = element_line(colour = "black"), 
          axis.ticks = element_line(colour = "black"), 
          axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, size = 10)) +
    theme_classic() +
    ggpubr::stat_compare_means(comparisons = list(c(2,3), c(1,3)), label = "p.format") +
    ggtitle(colnames(df_bl8)[i])
  
  print(plt)
}
```




```{r}
for(i in 5:6){
  plt <- df_bl8 %>% 
    mutate(antitnf_response = if_else(Donor == "p10","PR",antitnf_response)) %>% 
    mutate(antitnf_response = if_else(Donor == "p103","FR",antitnf_response)) %>% 
    mutate(antitnf_response = if_else(antitnf_response == "NOA","NM",antitnf_response)) %>% 
  dplyr::select(cor_var = i, antitnf_response, Group, Donor, Batch) %>% 
  mutate(cor_var = as.numeric(cor_var)) %>% 
  dplyr::filter(Group == "cd" & !(Donor == "p51" & Batch == "Batch6")) %>%  
mutate(resp2 = case_when(antitnf_response == "NM" ~0 ,
                         antitnf_response == "FR" ~ 1,
                         antitnf_response == "PR" ~ 2
                         )) %>% 
  
  ggplot(aes(x=factor(antitnf_response, levels = c("NM","FR","PR")), y=cor_var)) +
#geom_smooth(method=lm, fullrange = TRUE, se = F) +
ggpubr::stat_compare_means(comparisons = list(c(2,3)),label.y = 3) +
geom_violin(alpha = 0.3, aes(fill = antitnf_response), scale = "width") + 
#  geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA, aes(fill = antitnf_response)) +
 
ggbeeswarm::geom_beeswarm(size = 1.5, aes(color = antitnf_response), cex = 2, 
                shape = 16, corral = "random") +
 stat_summary(fun = "median",
               geom = "point", 
              shape = 21,
               size = 3,
               aes(fill = antitnf_response), color = "black") +
  ylab("Pct. from CD4") +
  xlab("") +
  ylim(c(0,5)) + 
  theme_classic() +
  theme(strip.background = element_blank(), 
        panel.grid = element_blank(),
        axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),
        axis.text.x = element_blank()) + ggtitle(colnames(df_bl8[i])) +
scale_color_manual(values = c("NM" = "grey88", "NOA" = "grey88", 
                             "FR" = "green3", "PR" = "orange")) +
scale_fill_manual(values = c("NM" = "grey88", "NOA" = "grey88", 
                             "FR" = "green3", "PR" = "orange")) +
ggtheme()
  
  print(plt)
}
```



```{r}
for(i in 5:6){
  plt <- df_bl8 %>% 
    mutate(antitnf_response = if_else(Donor == "p10","PR",antitnf_response)) %>% 
    mutate(antitnf_response = if_else(Donor == "p103","FR",antitnf_response)) %>% 
    mutate(antitnf_response = if_else(antitnf_response == "NOA","NM",antitnf_response)) %>% 
  dplyr::select(cor_var = i, antitnf_response, Group, Donor, Batch) %>% 
  mutate(cor_var = as.numeric(cor_var)) %>% 
  dplyr::filter(Group == "cd" & !(Donor == "p51" & Batch == "Batch6")) %>%  
mutate(resp2 = case_when(antitnf_response == "NM" ~0 ,
                         antitnf_response == "FR" ~ 1,
                         antitnf_response == "PR" ~ 2
                         )) %>% 
  
  ggplot(aes(x=resp2, y=cor_var)) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA, aes(fill = antitnf_response), alpha = 0.4, width = 0.8) + 
  geom_dotplot(binaxis='y', stackdir='center', dotsize=0) + 
  geom_jitter(position=position_jitter(0.05), size = 2, aes(color = antitnf_response)) +
      theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 22),
          axis.line = element_line(colour = "black"), 
        axis.ticks = element_line(colour = "black"), 
        axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, size = 10)
        ) +
      #ylim(c(0,1)) + 
  theme_classic() +
  ggpubr::stat_cor(alternative = "greater", label.y = 0.7) +
  ggtheme() +
    ggtitle(colnames(df_bl8)[i])
  
  print(plt)
}
```

```{r}
  mutate(cor_var = as.numeric(cor_var)) %>% 
  dplyr::filter(Group == "cd" & !(Donor == "p51" & Batch == "Batch6")) %>%  
mutate(resp2 = case_when(antitnf_response == "NM" ~0 ,
                         antitnf_response == "FR" ~ 1,
                         antitnf_response == "PR" ~ 2
                         )) %>% 
  
  ggplot(aes(x=resp2, y=cor_var)) +
  geom_violin(alpha = 0.3, aes(fill = antitnf_response), scale = "width") + 
#  geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA, aes(fill = antitnf_response)) +
 
ggbeeswarm::geom_beeswarm(size = 1.5, aes(color = antitnf_response), cex = 2, 
                shape = 16, corral = "random") +
  geom_smooth(method=lm, fullrange = TRUE, se = F) +
 stat_summary(fun = "median",
               geom = "point", 
              shape = 21,
               size = 3,
               aes(fill = antitnf_response), color = "black") +
  ylab("Pct. from CD4") +
  xlab("") +
  ylim(c(0,1)) + 
  theme_classic() +
  theme(strip.background = element_blank(), 
        panel.grid = element_blank(),
        axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),
        axis.text.x = element_blank()) + ggtitle(colnames(df_bl8[i])) +
  ggpubr::stat_cor(alternative = "greater", label.y = 0.7) +
  
scale_color_manual(values = c("NM" = "grey88", "NOA" = "grey88", 
                             "FR" = "green3", "PR" = "orange")) +
scale_fill_manual(values = c("NM" = "grey88", "NOA" = "grey88", 
                             "FR" = "green3", "PR" = "orange")) +
ggtheme() +
    ggtitle(colnames(df_bl8)[i])

plt
```

## Update metadata change

```{r}
md_5p_new <- read_csv("../predict_5p_metadata_20260819.csv")

md_response_join <- md_5p_new %>% dplyr::filter(timepoint == "T0") %>% 
  group_by(participant_id, antitnf_response) %>% tally()


df_test_response <- df_bl8

df_test_response
df_test_response <- df_test_response %>% mutate(participant_id = if_else(nchar(Donor) == 3, gsub(df_test_response$Donor, pattern = "^p", replacement = "001-0"), if_else(
 nchar(Donor) == 4, gsub(df_test_response$Donor, pattern = "^p", replacement = "001-"), Donor))) 


df_test_response <- df_test_response %>% left_join(md_response_join %>% dplyr::select(response = antitnf_response, participant_id))


df_test_response %>% group_by(participant_id, antitnf_response, response) %>% tally()
```

# Activation cytokines

```{r}
df <- read_excel("260413_Activation_Results_IFNG_IL27.xlsx")

df

colnames(df)[1] <- "sample"


df <-  df %>% separate(sample, into = c("Donor",NA, NA, "Activation",NA), sep = "_", remove = F)

```
```{r}
plt_list <- list()

for(i in c(5:8)){

   df_filt <- df %>% 
    dplyr::select(1:4,i)
  colnames(df_filt) <- c(colnames(df_filt[c(1:4)]), "value")
  df_filt$value <- as.numeric(df_filt$value)
 
 
  
plt <-  df_filt %>%  ggplot(aes(x = factor(Activation, levels = c("nothing","IFNg","IL27","IFNgIL27")),
             y = value)) +
  facet_wrap(~Group, ncol = 4) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA, aes(fill = Activation), alpha = 0.2) +
 geom_dotplot(binaxis='y', stackdir='center', dotsize=0) + 
geom_line(aes(group = sample, alpha = 0.1), color = "grey88") +
  geom_jitter(size = 3, position=position_jitter(width = 0.1, height = 0), 
              aes(fill = Activation, color = Activation)) + theme_classic() +
  #geom_line(aes(group = Donor), alpha = 0.3) + 
  xlab("Group") +  
  theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5), 
        strip.background = element_blank(),
        axis.text = element_text(color = "black", size = 16),
        axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),
        strip.text = element_text(size = 16)) + 
   scale_shape_manual(values = c(21,22,24)) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("nothing" = "grey75","IFNg" = "#4d99cdff", 
                                "IL27" = "#b37ab4ff", "IFNgIL27" = "#db6b69ff")) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("nothing" = "grey75","IFNg" = "#4d99cdff", 
                                "IL27" = "#b37ab4ff", "IFNgIL27" = "#db6b69ff")) +
  
  theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 22),
          axis.line = element_line(colour = "black"), 
        axis.ticks = element_line(colour = "black"), 
        axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90)
        ) +
   plot_annotation(
    title = paste(stringr::str_replace_all(string = colnames(df)[i], pattern = "/", replacement = "\n")) ,
    theme = theme(plot.title = element_text(size = 8), 
                  plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 8))) 

 print(plt)
 plt_list[[i-4]] <- plt
 
}
```
